title: Recording: Woman, Yes I’m Your Angel by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1980
content:
Hit Factory, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Jack Douglas
Engineer: Lee DeCarlo

The fourth recording session for John Lennon and Yoko Ono’s Double Fantasy album took place on 11 August 1980.

Two tracks were worked on, both of which were included on the album. The first was Lennon’s song ‘Woman’, followed by Ono’s ‘Yes, I’m Your Angel’.
